system.description: Renown carried over from your mortal days (or built since) that extends the reach of your other Backgrounds. Your Fame rating determines how far you can exert Contacts, Influence, or Resources without penalty: Fame x1 (local scene), x2 (city), x3 (state), x4 (adjoining states), x5 (entire country). Fame also makes you recognizable to mortals, for better or worse, and cannot be taken if you are known to be dead.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
